help.text:
When curl >= 7.7.0 and <= 7.78.0 is used with an MQTT server, the code that handles the CONNACK response can free a pointer twice when the server sends a malformed one: a double free in the MQTT sending function, which a malicious server can use to crash the client or, in some configurations, worse. The flaw is in lib/mqtt.c, where the send buffer is freed and then referenced again after a short write, so that a second call frees it once more. Applications that never speak MQTT are not affected, but the code is built into most distributions' libcurl.

|                |                   |
|----------------|-------------------|
| Package        | curl |
| Affected range | <7.74.0-1.3+deb11u2 |
